units.source_text: 搓麻将的时候，名人将怀纸折成细长条，把麻将排在上面。

en.t: When playing mahjong, the Master folded kaishi paper into long narrow strips and arranged the mahjong tiles on top of them.

units.source_text: 不论是怀纸折法，还是麻将摆法，他都弄得整整齐齐，郑重其事。

en.t: Whether it was the way he folded the kaishi paper or the way he set out the mahjong tiles, he made everything neat and orderly, treating it with solemn care.

units.source_text: 我以为这可能是名人的洁癖，不由得问了一句。

en.t: I thought this might be the Master's fastidiousness, and could not help asking him about it.
